pointers.sentence: `SimpleAdminConfig.ready` registers both functions, and `AdminConfig.ready` calls it before `autodiscover` (`django/contrib/admin/apps.py:SimpleAdminConfig.ready`).

The middleware are looked for by class: `_contains_subclass` imports each path in `MIDDLEWARE` and is satisfied by the class required or a subclass of it (`django/contrib/admin/checks.py:_contains_subclass`).

`check_admin_app` calls `AdminSite.check` on each site in `all_sites`, a weak set that `AdminSite.__init__` adds every site to, so a site is checked whether or not its URLs are in the URLconf, as long as something holds it (`django/contrib/admin/checks.py:check_admin_app`).

`AdminSite.check` passes over a model admin whose class is `ModelAdmin` itself, one its docstring calls not customized at all, and checks each other one whose model belongs to an application the run was given, or to any when it was given none (`django/contrib/admin/sites.py:AdminSite.check`).
`BaseModelAdmin.check` makes an instance of the class in `BaseModelAdmin.checks_class` and hands it the model admin (`django/contrib/admin/options.py:BaseModelAdmin.check`).

An inline is checked through its parent: for each class in `inlines` that inherits from `InlineModelAdmin` and names a model, `ModelAdminChecks` makes an instance with the parent's model and site and calls its `check` (`django/contrib/admin/checks.py:ModelAdminChecks._check_inlines_item`).

The checks read the options as attributes and call none of the hooks, which take a request; the check of `list_display_links` against `list_display` is skipped when the class overrides `ModelAdmin.get_list_display` (`django/contrib/admin/checks.py:ModelAdminChecks._check_list_display_links`).

Only the actions whose locations include `ActionLocation.CHANGE_LIST` are looked at: each permission in an action's `"allowed_permissions"` needs a method named after it, as `BaseModelAdmin.has_change_permission` is after `"change"`, and no two of them may share a name (`django/contrib/admin/checks.py:ModelAdminChecks._check_actions`, `django/contrib/admin/options.py:ModelAdmin._get_base_actions`).

`InlineModelAdminChecks` asks `_get_foreign_key` for the inline's foreign key to the parent, by `fk_name` if set, reports its error as `"admin.E202"`, and refuses an `exclude` naming that key (`django/contrib/admin/checks.py:InlineModelAdminChecks._check_relation`, `django/contrib/admin/checks.py:InlineModelAdminChecks._check_exclude_of_parent_model`).

A name in `fields` or `fieldsets` that is not a field passes, since, a comment says, it could be an extra field of the form (`django/contrib/admin/checks.py:BaseModelAdminChecks._check_field_spec_item`), and `search_fields` is checked only for its type.

Most messages take one of three shapes, made by `must_be`, `must_inherit_from` and `refer_to_missing_field`: the option, or the item at fault with its index, and what it must be, must inherit from, or names that the model lacks (`django/contrib/admin/checks.py:must_be`).
